DIAGNOSIS READY: Myasthenia Gravis.

Based on your presentation of fluctuating weakness that worsens with activity (difficulty climbing stairs and upper limb weakness) accompanied by double vision, and the normal results from the initial blood work (CBC, electrolytes, thyroid, CK, B12) which rule out metabolic, endocrine, and inflammatory causes, the clinical picture strongly points to a neuromuscular junction disorder.
